implementation_role: repaired candidate derivation; implementer did not review this artifact
solution_concept: perfect Bayesian equilibrium with the Gate 0 response-at-equality rule and no additional selection or correlating device
state_key: (M,round=2,H=active,full h2,nu(h2)) before the uniform weak-proposer recognition draw

domain.quota: q=floor(N/2)+1, unchanged after an H no vote

belief_layers.on_support_proposal: rho(s)=nu because the weak proposer has no private information and recognition is type-independent
belief_layers.globally_off_path_proposal: rho(s) is an explicitly recorded assessment component in [0,1]
belief_layers.deviation_distribution: the proposer evaluates every proposal deviation under the true preproposal distribution nu, never under rho(s)
belief_layers.terminal_update: after a positive-probability H ballot a, posterior type-one probability is rho(s)1{h_1=a}/[(1-rho(s))1{h_0=a}+rho(s)1{h_1=a}]; the weak vote vector is type-independent conditional on s
belief_layers.zero_probability_terminal_history: the terminal posterior is stated as an assessment component, but no later player moves and no terminal payoff depends on it

notation.p_j: independent behavioral probability that weak nonproposer j votes yes

terminal_transitions.outcome: pass weak-only after immediate H opt-out; y reabsorbed

hegemon.relevance: H changes at least opt-out status at every weak vote profile, so its relevance probability is one
hegemon.strategy: h_theta=yes iff A_p=0 or y>=o_theta; otherwise no
hegemon.equality: yes at y=o_theta and yes when A_p=0

weak_nonproposer_j.strategy: p_j=1 if R_j>0; p_j may be any number in [0,1] if R_j=0
weak_nonproposer_j.equality: yes when R_j>0 even if x_j=0; R_j=0 actions are explicit completions
weak_nonproposer_j.independence: all weak behavioral randomizations are independent conditional on the ballot information set

complete_fixed_proposal_ballot_correspon.no_interior_A: every equilibrium has A_p=0 or A_p=1; none has 0<A_p<1

failure_class_F.existence: if and only if q>=4, equivalently N>=6
failure_class_F.mixed_completions: at most q-4 weak voters may have arbitrary positive yes probabilities; every other weak voter uses zero

secured_class_S.existence: for every N>=3, rho, and feasible proposal
secured_class_S.remaining_completions: every nonsure weak voter may use any independent probability in [0,1]
secured_class_S.B_boundary: if t_rho_y<1 then B_p=1; if t_rho_y=1 then B_p may lie anywhere in [0,1]
secured_class_S.belief_warning: when t_rho_y=1, a type assigned zero probability by rho may reject and receive weak-only passage only with probability B_p; that type can still have positive probability under true nu at an off-path proposal

rho_boundaries: if y<o_0, then t_rho_y=0 for every rho
if o_0<=y<o_1, then t_rho_y=1-rho, so rho=0 permits B_p in [0,1] while every rho>0 forces B_p=1
if y>=o_1, then t_rho_y=1 for every rho, but both types accept so B_p does not affect realized type payoffs

fixed_proposal_outcome_and_payoff_corres.secured_simplification: in S, g_i=[t_nu_y+(1-t_nu_y)B_p](1-X)-t_nu_y y; only at an on-support proposal rho=nu does this always reduce to 1-X-t_nu_y y
fixed_proposal_outcome_and_payoff_corres.failure_simplification: in F, g_i=0, every weak payoff is zero, and g_H=o_bar_nu

proposal_assessment.components: a proposal distribution sigma_i; rho_i(s)=nu on its support and an explicit rho_i(s) at every globally off-path proposal; one fixed-proposal ballot element b_i(s) satisfying the rho_i(s) correspondence; terminal beliefs; full proposal/type/identity outcome vectors
proposal_assessment.proposer_support: support is contained in argmax_s g_i(s,b_i(s);nu), with deviations integrated under true nu
proposal_assessment.tie_break: after proposer-payoff maximization, retain only maximizers minimizing g_H(s,b_i(s);nu); if proposer and H payoffs tie while allocations, type outcomes, identities, or terminal signatures differ, retain the correspondence
proposal_assessment.proposal_mixing: all support elements have the same maximal proposer payoff and the same tie-minimal H payoff; otherwise the higher-H element is removed by the primitive tie-break
proposal_assessment.warning: rho(s), B_p, gifts, and full ballot completions are proposal-contingent; no common minimal-coalition or zero-gift convention is imposed

N_3_to_5_o0_positive.reason: the deviation y=0,X=0 has both H types reject under every rho and therefore forces B_p=1 and payoff one
N_3_to_5_o0_positive.multiplicity: proposal, inclusion/opt-out signature, off-support type outcome, and ballot completion may remain multiple

lower_bound_components.G: 1-o_1, forced by the pooling deviation y=o_1,X=0
lower_bound_components.L: 1-nu, forced by the deviation y=0,X=0; its minimum is attained off path with rho=0, exactly q-2 sure weak yes votes, and B_p=0

N_3_to_5_o0_zero.attainment: every V in [D,1] is attained on path by y=0,X=1-V with rho=nu and an S completion
N_3_to_5_o0_zero.off_path_punishment: every separating deviation can be assigned rho=0 and B_p=0, yielding true-nu payoff (1-nu)r_i<=L; every pooling deviation yields at most G
N_3_to_5_o0_zero.interior_V_above_D: any on-support S outcome with proposer payoff V>D is supportable by assigning every other proposal payoff strictly below V

boundary_V_equals_D.if_L_greater_than_G: the unavoidable y=0,X=0 tie gives H o_bar_nu, so support outcomes must have g_H=o_bar_nu
boundary_V_equals_D.if_G_greater_than_L: the unavoidable y=o_1,X=0 tie gives H o_1, so support outcomes must have g_H<=o_1
boundary_V_equals_D.if_G_equals_L: the two unavoidable ties make o_bar_nu the minimum H payoff, so support outcomes must have g_H=o_bar_nu

N_3_to_5_o0_zero.degenerate_corner: if nu=1 and o_1=1, then D=0; y=0,X=1 and y=1,X=0 are the two pure proposal forms with value zero, and both give the actual H type payoff one

N_at_least_6.positive_value_support: every on-support S outcome with V=1-X-t_nu_y y>0 is supportable by assigning F to all other proposals; every V in (0,1] is attainable with y=0,X=1-V
N_at_least_6.zero_value_support: F outcomes at arbitrary proposals, plus on-support S outcomes satisfying 1-X-t_nu_y y=0 and g_H=o_bar_nu
N_at_least_6.zero_value_S_equivalent_conditions: either y=0,X=1; or y>0,t_nu_y=1,X=1-y and every type with positive nu probability has o_theta=y
N_at_least_6.noninvariance: zero-value F gives all weak states zero while zero-value S may give nonproposing weak states the entire unit; both survive the stated tie-break

recognized_proposer_correspondence.object: all type-conditional payoff vectors, proposal distributions, rho maps, local ballot completions, terminal-outcome distributions, terminal beliefs, and named weak allocations generated by the exact assessment characterization
recognized_proposer_correspondence.scalar_projection_warning: the proposer payoff projections are implications of, not replacements for, the full continuation interface

pre_recognition_interface.recognition: each weak i is recognized with probability 1/m independently of theta and public history
pre_recognition_interface.correspondence: C2_M_active(h2)={(1/m)sum_i U^{i,alpha_i}: alpha_i is an admissible recognized-proposer PBE assessment at true posterior nu(h2)}
pre_recognition_interface.terminal_signature_coordinate: the same uniform average is retained over PR11-PR14 probabilities, H inclusion/opt-out status, and implemented payment vectors
pre_recognition_interface.history_index: full h2 is retained separately from nu because rho maps and completion maps may differ across equal-posterior histories
pre_recognition_interface.proposer_mixing: expectations over tie-refined proposer mixtures are included

existence_and_multiplicity.existence: nonempty for every admissible primitive vector, N>=3, nu, and full history h2
existence_and_multiplicity.N_3_to_5: the proposer value is one when o_0>0, but is the interval [max{1-o_1,1-nu},1] when o_0=0; full outcomes remain more numerous than these scalar projections
existence_and_multiplicity.N_at_least_6: proposal-contingent F completions generate proposer values [0,1] and a broad payoff/outcome correspondence
existence_and_multiplicity.selection_status: set-valued; no selection beyond the primitive proposer/H tie-break has been imposed

boundary_cases: N=3: q=2 and b=0; in S, t_rho_y=1 requires no sure weak yes while t_rho_y<1 requires the sole weak nonproposer to be sure yes
N=4,5: q=3 and b=1; F is impossible; S requires one sure weak yes at t_rho_y=1 and two at t_rho_y<1
N>=6: F exists and is exactly L_p<=q-4
nu=0 or nu=1: true type probabilities used for proposal optimality may differ from off-path rho; both type strategies and counterfactual payoff coordinates remain recorded
rho=0 at a separating off-path proposal permits B_p in [0,1], including the payoff-minimizing B_p=0 completion
rho=1 at a separating proposal has t_rho_y=0 and forces B_p=1
x_j=0 and R_j>0: weak j votes yes
invalidation: any change to the Gate 0 bundle invalidates this interface and all descendants; R1 must import the reviewed frozen replacement and apply beta exactly once
